headline: Europe plans 50 billion euro tech fund to challenge US and China
label: NEWS
caption:
Europe is stepping up its global tech game with a massive new financial push 🇪🇺

According to Reuters and the Financial Times, Europe plans to launch a 50 billion euro sovereign tech equity fund.

The goal of this major initiative is to boost quantum technology and challenge the dominance of the United States and China in the tech sector.
